question: Identify an element that is NOT a semi-metal.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Caesium.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• ** A semi-metal, also known as a metalloid, is an element that has properties of both metals and non-metals. It typically has a shiny appearance, but is brittle and can be a poor conductor of electricity.**
 
• Cesium is a highly reactive alkali metal and is not a semi-metal. It is a soft, silvery-golden alkali metal with a melting point of only 28.5, making it one of the few metals that are liquid at or near room temperature.
 
• The chemical elements known as semimetals or metalloids are those that share characteristics with both metals and nonmetals.
